name: Overloaded: Pursuing Fire
description:
Roll Phase: Always roll 2 Electro Dice and 2 Pyro Dice.
After the opponent has switched characters 3 times: Before your next Action, draw 1 card and automatically play the card with the highest Cost from your Hand for free.
